items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: Him and Rapp, probably the greatest white clarinet players that ever come out of New Orleans.

ctx.x: Yeah, we had a nice idea with him last year. Of course, over here to the left is a picture of Sharky, one of New Orleans' real greats that's

left today in the Dixieland field. On the left over here we have Mark Hazel. In my opinion, probably one of the greatest Dixieland drummers in the business. Under him we have Fazola. In my opinion, another one of the real great clarinet players. Him and Rapp, probably the greatest white clarinet players that ever come out of New Orleans.

If there's anything of particular interest about these pictures, if you remember the dates of any of them, like we know the one down below the New Orleans Rhythm Kings, but Paul's, if you remember about the date?
